comment: canopyFill: share of a measured trees.canopyShare to reach with extra yard trees; maxTreesPerKm2: render-budget ceiling on mapped + generated trees (raise when far tree LODs get cheaper). Yard and street-tree rules per style profile ID (generator defaults; profiles without an entry use 'default'). streetTreeSpacing and yardTreesPerHouse are seeded from regions-chicagoland-miami proposedAdditions (streetTreeSpacingMeters, yardTreesPerEligibleResidentialCell). All values are design judgments [J]; trees.canopyShare in a profile, when measured, is the calibration target. Lots are inferred yard cells for dressing only: never cadastral boundaries, never navigation.
